sources.title: Qwen3-8b-urban-qwen-20260920-full-CPT-final-step-1500
sources.snippet: Training: 10,072 distinct documents plus 2,000 repeat exposures per epoch; 200 disjoint validation documents. Merged with Unsloth's native save_pretrained_merged (save_method="merged_16bit"). Weights are validated BF16 and packaged losslessly into eight safetensors shards. No adapter is required to load this model.

sources.title: Qwen3-8B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-8B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑8B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 8 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: CompassioninMachineLearning/Qwen-3-8b-final-CPT-10k-urban-density-dataset
sources.snippet: Model Overview This model, Qwen3-8b-urban-qwen-20260920-full-CPT-final-step-1500, is a standalone, merged BF16 version of a Qwen3-8b base model, fine-tuned by BrandonHowe. It was developed over 1500 steps, reaching epoch 3.97, and features a substantial 32768 token context length.
